summary: Snail, Inc. filed an amendment to its ATM prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) to update the amount of shares it may sell under its existing at-the-market offering agreement with H.C. Wainwright. The registrant may offer up to $3.66 million of Class A common stock, with prior sales of $4.37 million already executed. The ATM program is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation event such as a tender, going-private, or restructuring. No extraordinary corporate action or strategic review is being announced.
